scope: Read-only diagnosis restricted to the same fixed 240 TRAIN DTOs and TRAIN-selected metadata/results in existing inputs/run/metrics/text-domain-v5 manifests. Native-method subset of merged analysis.evidence. No PDF or truth file read, no scorer reevaluation, no browser/OCR/image processing, no product-source or existing-evidence edits. Reserved/holdout and old sealed binary/generators not accessed.
readScopeNote: During initial schema inspection, one existing public-exploratory fukuoka-park-activity DTO was read. It is excluded from all diagnostic computations and row examples. All quantitative comparisons use only split=train, 240 identical IDs.
conclusion: All additional 2,133 native-method deletions are exactly accounted for by 446 baseline-native rows retained as same-text overlapping OCR rows in corrected merged evidence. The existing geometry-first, method-agnostic dedupe rule keeps these OCR rows first. This is a change in retained method provenance within merged evidence, and supplies no evidence of a worsened native parser. Raw premerge native extraction is not captured in either run and was not measured here.

method.comparisonSignature: pageIndex + exact text + exact ordered quad; excludes run-specific UUID only
method.replacementCriteria: same page, trim-equal text, box IoU > 0.55, OCR sorts before baseline native by descending box.minY then ascending box.minX
method.characterCounting: NFC Unicode code points; only diagnosis of retained native rows, no candidate-assisted GT changes
method.replay: Apply current mergeTextEvidence sorting/dedupe semantics to baseline merged-native rows plus corrected selected final-tile raw OCR evidence. Compare resulting native signature multiset to corrected merged-native signature multiset. This is not a reconstruction or measurement of the full raw native stream.
